title: Context Priority Configuration
description: User-defined file priority hints for context optimization. Allows explicit control over which files should be prioritized or excluded from AI context.

additionalProperties.description: Priority configuration for a file path or glob pattern

priority.description: Priority level for context selection. Higher values indicate greater importance.

reason.description: Optional explanation for why this priority level was set (useful for team documentation)

comment.description: Additional notes or comments about this priority rule

$schema.description: JSON Schema identifier (optional, for IDE validation)

x-documentation.usage: Place this file at .auto-claude/context-priority.json in your project root.
x-documentation.pattern_matching: Keys support glob patterns using fnmatch. Examples: '**/*.py', 'apps/backend/**', '*.test.js'
x-documentation.conflict_resolution: More specific patterns take precedence over general patterns. Explicit file paths take precedence over patterns.
